items.title: Busan Workshop Schedule Notice
items.author: Program Coordinator
items.content:
Hello everyone!


We are pleased to announce that the Busan Workshop will be held this week from June 18 - June 20 for a 3-day journey.

Please review the key schedule and details below to ensure a smooth and punctual transition for all activities and travel.


📌 Workshop Overview

  • Period: June 18, 2026 (Thu) – June 20, 2026 (Sat) [3 Days & 2 Nights]
  • Accommodation: Commodore Hotel Busan (코모도호텔 부산)
  • Objectives: This workshop aims to empower trainees by delivering specialized knowledge through a marketing strategy session and an expert lecture, combined with local industry and cultural exploration


🗓️ June 18 [Day 1]

Time Activity Location/ Note
08:00-12:00 Travel from Seoul ➡️ Busan & Check-in via KTX / Commodity Hotel Busan
12:00-14:00 Lunch
15:00-17:00 Haedong Yonggungsa Temple Tour Haedong Yonggungsa
17:00-19:00 [Seminar] Busan's Maritime Culture and Coastal Infrastructure
19:00-20:00 Dinner in Haeundae
20:00-21:00 Haeundae Nightscape Observation in Haeundae


🗓️ June 19 [Day 2]

Time Activity Location/ Note
08:00-09:00 Breakfast
10:00-12:00 Networking Session: Building Global Fellowship
12:00-13:30 Lunch Gukje Market (International Market)
14:00-16:00 Gamcheon Culture Village Tour
17:00-18:00 [Special Lecture] US Startup Ecosystem • Guest Speaker: Prof. Yong-Seok Jang • Hotel Meeting Room
18:00-21:00 Official Networking Dinner


🗓️ June 20 [Day 3]

Time Activity Location/ Note
08:00-09:00 Breakfast
09:00-10:00 Break & Check-out
10:00-11:30 [Seminar] Marketing Plan Seminar • Expert Review & Feedback by Prof. Hyejin Bang • Hotel Meeting Room
12:00-13:00 Lunch & Wrap-up
13:30-16:00 Return to Seoul via KTX

> Please note that the schedule is subject to minor changes depending on local circumstances or traffic conditions.



📌 Notes:

  • Please arrive at Seoul Station by 7:50 AM on June 18th. Since we will be traveling together by KTX, please strictly adhere to this time to ensure we don't miss the train.
  • For outdoor tours (Temples, Villages, and Markets), comfortable clothing and walking shoes are highly recommended. Also, if you would like to go swimming, feel free to bring an extra change of clothes! 🏊‍♂️✨



If you have any inquiries, please contact me.

We look forward to a safe and fruitful journey with you all!


Thank you 😊

items.title: 🏮Lotus Lantern Festival(Yeondeunghoe) 2026
items.author: Program Coordinator
items.content:
The festival is a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage.

Here is the schedule for this weekend's main events in Seoul!


Dates: Saturday, May 16 – Sunday, May 17, 2026


1. Main Event: Lotus Lantern Parade 🐉

  • When: Saturday, May 16 | 7:00 PM – 9:30 PM
  • Where: From Heunginjimun (Dongdaemun) → along Jongno Street → Jogyesa Temple
  • Tip: This is the highlight of the festival with over 100,000 lanterns!


2. Post-Parade Celebration (Daedong Hanmadang) 🎊

  • When: Saturday, May 16 | 9:30 PM – 11:00 PM
  • Where: Jonggak Intersection
  • Details: Flower rain (confetti) and traditional dancing.


3. Traditional Culture Events 🎨

  • When: Sunday, May 17 | 11:00 AM – 7:00 PM
  • Where: The street in front of Jogyesa Temple
  • Details: Experience making lanterns, trying temple food, and traditional games.


4. Final Celebration (Yeondeungnori) ✨

  • When: Sunday, May 17 | 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM
  • Where: Insadong to Jogyesa Temple street
  • Details: A final, smaller-scale parade and concert to wrap up the festival.


📍 How to get there: The best way is by Subway!

  • Line 1: Jonggak Station, Jongno 3-ga Station, or Dongdaemun Station.
  • Line 3: Anguk Station.

⚠️ Note: There will be major road closures in the Jongno area during the parade, so using the subway is highly recommended!

items.title: [Assignment #1] Developing Your Own Business Concept
items.author: Program Coordinator
items.content:
Dear Participants,

Following today’s lecture, we are pleased to announce your first assignment.


1. Assignment Overview

Identify a Business Opportunity within the context of Laos and develop it into a concrete Business Concept.


2. Key Guidelines

When brainstorming your business idea, consider the following perspectives:

  • Market & Industry Analysis: Which industries show growth potential in the current Laotian market?
  • Problem-Solving: What specific inconveniences or existing problems do people in Laos face, and how can they be solved?
  • Demographics & Trends: What opportunities arise from changes in Laos' population structure or new lifestyle trends?
  • Personal Network & Information: How can you leverage your professional networks or unique information/resources?


3. Format and Length

  • Format: MS Word
  • Length: Approximately 2 pages (A4 size)


4. Submission Details

  • Submission Deadline: By this Sunday, May 3rd, 2026
  • To: bchoi@hufs.ac.kr
  • Cc (Carbon Copy): seongeun38@kookmin.ac.kr
  • Note: Your idea can be changed or modified at any time throughout the course. The primary goal is to start the journey with "your own idea" rather than producing a perfect final product from the start.
